{{Top|leg}}
'''Terelya''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Terelya commented on the entry for the [[CV14-B Concussion Vest]] in the Datalog.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
